svg.text: Five sub-loops, one per architecture, each run by its own human expertise. A stage-level check keeps them consistent. Any declining attribute is escalated to its human owner.
Design is chained to the requirements loop
Business entities exist in the data model. Services map to infrastructure. UI flows map to APIs.
Reads all five artifacts and sends findings to the human who owns each affected sub-loop.
Suggested dependency order, to be confirmed: business, then software and data, then infrastructure. UI/UX draws on requirements and business architecture.
Shared core also applies: clarity, traceability, currency, provenance, boundaries, validated assumptions
The validator is strongest on structure (traceability, consistency, coverage). Whether an architecture is good stays with the humans.
Feeds: intent building, grooming, task creation and implementation
